propositions: pending_enrichment walks all ticket directories and calls reduce_ticket on each, issuing ~24,000 filesystem metadata syscalls per gate check, consuming 486-740 ms against a 20 ms budget on every write
The drain gate warning fires on 100% of writes to a 4,810+ ticket store, masking genuine future breaches and rendering the budget signal inoperative as an observability tool

Multiple concurrent gate checks contend on the kernel vnode cache, causing the gate latency to scale with concurrent writer count rather than just store size, creating positive feedback where gate overhead extends write windows and increases check overlap

An O(1) marker file under .rebar/enrich-gate.json records the next eligible drain time, allowing quiet-store probes to return immediately without scanning the ticket directory while degrading gracefully on marker loss or corruption
